cadenas.Excavación en terreno de alta compacidad: Excavation in ground of high compaction, cemented material or rock, with a hydraulic breaker mounted on a backhoe, with a hand-held pneumatic breaker for the corners. It applies where the output of conventional excavation falls below what is acceptable, a circumstance that must be recorded on site to justify the change of item. Includes breaking up the material, extracting and stockpiling it, trimming the sides and bottom, and controlling vibration where there are adjoining buildings. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.

cadenas.Excavación manual en el interior de una: Hand excavation inside an existing building, for reducing levels, constructing strengthening foundations or running buried services. Output is far lower than for open-cut excavation because of the lack of room to manoeuvre, the impossibility of using plant and the need to carry the material out by hand through the building. Includes setting out, protecting the circulation areas, excavating in layers with pick and shovel, bagging the material and carrying it to the external stockpile. Disposal is not included.
cadenas.Excavación manual en zanja de sección re: Hand excavation of a narrow trench for laying water pipes, drains or buried electrical conduits, to the fall required by the service. It is done by hand precisely because in built-up areas the risk of striking an existing service makes the machine inadvisable. Includes setting out the line, excavating in layers under continuous watch, stockpiling the material alongside the trench, trimming the bottom to the required fall and keeping the trench signed while it remains open. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Excavación manual en zanja o pozo para f: Hand excavation of a trench or pit for foundations, in ground of medium consistency, to the level and to the design dimensions. It is the usual solution on refurbishment work and extensions where plant cannot get in or the volume does not justify it. Includes setting out the trench, excavating in layers with pick and shovel, stockpiling the material far enough back from the edge not to overload it, trimming the sides and bottom, and getting the material out to the loading point. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.

It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design levels.
cadenas.Excavación mecanizada en zanja o pozo pa: Mechanical excavation of a trench or pit for foundations with a backhoe, in ground of medium consistency, to the level and to the design dimensions. Includes setting out, excavation by machine, stockpiling the material far enough back from the edge, hand trimming of the sides and bottom that the machine cannot achieve, and watching during excavation so that work stops if unforeseen buried services are found. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.

Includes setting out, excavation by mechanical means with hand trimming, trimming the bottom to the exact bearing level, checking the stability of the sides and sheeting them where the depth requires it, and signing and covering the void while it remains open. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.

cadenas.Formación de pendientes en cubierta plan: Formation of falls on a flat roof with a lightweight mortar fill, to the varying thickness needed to direct water to the roof drains at the minimum gradient specified. cadenas.Formación de pendientes sobre base de cu: Screed to falls over the roof deck in cement mortar lightweightened with expanded clay or polystyrene, to direct water to the drainage points. cadenas.Formación del alero y del remate del bor: Formation of the eaves and the edge trim of the roof, with the closing unit, drip edge and sealant. Includes setting out, placing the trim with its projection, forming the drip, sealing the junction with the roof and with the wall and fixing. Measured by the length actually constructed.
